punchline: The sergeants refused their commander; years later Winters said his training helped Easy succeed.
thirty_sec: In the winter of 1943–44 at Aldbourne, Easy Company's noncommissioned officers said they would give up their stripes unless Captain Herbert Sobel was replaced. Colonel Sink sent him to a training school at Chilton Foliat, and Lieutenant Thomas Meehan took command in February 1944. Dick Winters later said Sobel's tough training helped Easy succeed.
question: If you listed separately what a difficult boss or teacher gave you and what that person cost you, what would each list contain?
key_contrast: Judging how someone leads and judging what they produce are two questions.
